verified.name: Pharma manufacturer registries — uzpharm-control.uz GMP register, apteka.uz producer directory, Uzfarmsanoat enterprise dataset
verified.what_you_get: State register of pharmaceutical manufacturers certified to O'zDSt 2766:2018 (GMP): organisation, certificate no., validity, registry no., production scope. apteka.uz lists Uzbek producers by district with profiles; old open-data dataset lists Uzfarmsanoat holding enterprises (CSV/JSON). Pharma plants import Chinese production lines, APIs, excipients, packaging — container volumes.
verified.volume_signal: Register covers all GMP-certified producers (dozens–~150); some certificates expired 2022–2024; Uzfarmsanoat dataset ~10 years old.
verified.reason: Core claim holds: the exact URL https://uzpharm-control.uz/pages/certified-pharmaceutical-manufacturers was returned in search with the title "Государственный реестр сертифицированных фармацевтических производителей на соответствия государственному стандарту O'zDSt 2766:2018"; snippet shows per-entry organisation, production line/scope, issue date and expiry date, with some entries already expired (e.g. 26.02.2023). The host is alive in 2025–2026 (news items dated 2025-04-24 and 2026-01-08 on the same domain; it also hosts the certified-medicines registry and the state register of medicines). So the source exists, is public, free, and is company-level — not aggregate. Caveats found: (1) the register snippet looks historical; current GMP/GSP certificates (2024–2027 validity, e.g. issued 30.08.2024 expiring 29.08.2027) are published by the State Center for Good Practices on uzpharm-gxp.uz registries, so uzpharm-control.uz alone may miss recent certifications (e.g. Jurabek Laboratories GMP-3422024 issued after a Sept-2024 inspection). (2) No search result supported an apteka.uz producer directory — apteka.uz surfaced only as a drug reference/review/vacancy site; the /companies/proiz page was not found. (3) The olddata.gov.uz Uzfarmsanoat dataset did not surface at all; it is unverified and the holding has since been superseded by the Agency for Pharmaceutical Industry Development (2019 decree transferred licensing). (4) The register carries no phone/Telegram/STIR; contacts must come from yellowpages.uz / goldenpages.uz rubrics, which do exist with addresses and phones by city/district. Industry size supports the yield estimate: ~125 licensed pharma manufacturers (anhor.uz, older figure).
verified.access_now: Public HTML pages, no login or paywall indicated. uzpharm-control.uz register page (RU/EN variants) and uzpharm-gxp.uz registries (registry7 = GSP; other numbered registries for GMP incl. foreign manufacturers) are indexed and live as of 2025–2026. WebFetch/curl may be blocked in this environment; a normal scraper or headless browser should work. yellowpages.uz and goldenpages.uz pharma-production rubrics are public and give address/phone.
verified.extraction_plan: Step 1: scrape uzpharm-control.uz/pages/certified-pharmaceutical-manufacturers (RU and EN pages) into rows: organisation, certificate no., production line/scope, issue date, expiry date. Step 2: scrape uzpharm-gxp.uz/ru/registry1..N (GMP domestic, GMP foreign, GSP) for 2023–2026 certificates; union with step 1, dedupe by normalised organisation name. Step 3: flag active = expiry >= today; keep expired-within-24-months as "recertifying" (equipment upgrade signal). Step 4: enrich each organisation with address/phone/district from yellowpages.uz rubric farmacevticheskie-preparaty-proizvodstvo and goldenpages.uz rubric Id=1800; resolve STIR via a company directory (not verified here). Step 5: score: sterile/injectable/infusion lines and new plants = highest (production lines, glass vials, aluminium foil, PVC/PVDC blister film, cartons from China in 20/40ft); tablet/capsule lines = medium (API drums, excipients, packaging, recurring LCL 3–10 m3); herbal/galenic = low. Step 6: push to LogisticsERP webhook with tag "pharma-manufacturer", route to the industrial-equipment import manager; re-run monthly to catch new certificates.
verified.corrections: 1) Drop or mark unverified: apteka.uz/companies/proiz producer directory (not found; apteka.uz is a drug-reference/review/vacancy site) and olddata.gov.uz dataset 2058 (not found; Uzfarmsanoat holding data is obsolete after the 2019 transfer of oversight to the Agency for Pharmaceutical Industry Development). 2) Add uzpharm-gxp.uz (GUP "Центр надлежащих практик") registries as the primary source of currently valid GMP/GSP certificates; the uzpharm-control.uz register appears to be a legacy list with many expired entries. 3) Register fields confirmed: organisation, production line/scope, issue date, expiry date; "state registry number" and certificate number are plausible but not seen in snippets. 4) Register has no contacts/STIR/Telegram — enrichment via yellowpages.uz / goldenpages.uz rubric 1800 is mandatory. 5) Coverage should be "medium" not "high": ~125 licensed manufacturers nationally, only GMP-certified subset is listed; wholesale importers of APIs/packaging that are not manufacturers are absent. 6) Jan-2026 rule change exempts orphan/WHO-prequalified/recognition-procedure products from national GMP, so future register growth may slow.

Shop page (per Uzum's own seller oferta) must carry full legal name / FIO, state registration number, address (legal entities) and email/phone -> maps a shop to a legal entity for STIR lookup. Platform scale: >18k sellers (2026, ~90% SME), 1.3-1.9M local SKUs, GMV >$500M in 2025, 34M orders, ~1500 PVZ; claimed >70% of UZ e-commerce.
verified.volume_signal: Order counts per SKU and SKU count per shop are public; sum orders x category bulk factor over 30 days to estimate m3/month. Shops with many bulky-category SKUs (furniture, home, appliances, toys, sport, auto) and hundreds of monthly orders are the >=3 m3/month candidates. Press: sellers with active sales +32% YTD 2026.
verified.reason: Source exists and is reachable in 2026. Two live Apify actors confirmed: getascraper/uzum-scraper (keyword search -> per-product price, discount %, rating, ORDER COUNT, review count, category, image; priced from $3.30 per 1,000 product records) and maximedupre/uzum (titles, prices, links, discounts, ratings, order counts 'only when the source provides them', images; from $2.95 per 1,000 listings). parse.bot 'Uzum Market API' confirmed with 7 endpoints incl. get_seller_info (seller slug -> rating, reviews, registration date, description) and get_product_details (includes a seller field). Company-level mapping is supported by Uzum's own seller oferta (seller.uzum.uz/seller/agreement/, clause 5.3): seller must display on the shop page full legal name, state registration number (OGRN), address and location -> shop pages carry legal-entity identifiers usable for STIR lookup. Not refuted: no evidence the site is dead, paywalled or aggregate-only. Limits: no official public catalog API found (api.umarket.uz/graphql unconfirmed); the Apify actors are keyword/product-level and the search summaries did not confirm a shop/seller field in their rows; parse.bot get_seller_info returns rating/reviews/reg-date/description, not the legal name/OGRN -> legal data must be parsed from shop page HTML by own crawler. Source gives seller identity + sales velocity proxy, NOT import facts or m3 per shipment; anti-bot claim from prior agent not re-verified in these searches.
verified.access_now: Public catalog, no login. Paid turnkey: Apify getascraper/uzum-scraper $3.30/1k product records; maximedupre/uzum $2.95/1k listings (keyword-search input, JSON output, pay-per-result). parse.bot Uzum Market API: paid, 7 endpoints (get_category_products, search_products, get_product_details, get_product_reviews, get_seller_info, etc.), price not shown. Shop-page legal name/OGRN/address are mandated by seller oferta 5.3 and must be read from shop pages directly (own crawler; anti-bot/proxy requirement per prior agent, not re-verified). No official public catalog API; anythingmcp/seller OpenAPI only exposes the key owner's own shop.
verified.extraction_plan: Phase 1 (cheap, turnkey): run getascraper/uzum-scraper on 40-80 bulky-category keywords (mebel, divan, shkaf, kovyor, stiralnaya mashina, velosiped, avtozapchasti, santehnika, svetilnik, igrushki, sport trenazher, etc.) weekly; store product_id, title, category, price, order_count, review_count. Phase 2: for each product_id call parse.bot get_product_details to capture seller slug/name; aggregate per seller: SKU count, sum(order_count), weekly delta. Phase 3: own low-rate Playwright crawl (UZ/KZ residential proxy, no login) of shop pages for top ~2-3k sellers by bulky-order velocity; regex-extract legal name, OGRN/state reg number, address; resolve to STIR via orginfo/ihamkor-type registry; push to LogisticsERP webhook with score = bulky_orders_30d x category m3 factor. Keep only legal entities/IE (B2B); drop sellers whose legal name is Uzum's own brands. Re-verify shop-page field availability on 10 sample shops before scaling.
verified.corrections: 1) Cost: Apify Uzum actors are priced $3.30/1k (getascraper) and $2.95/1k (maximedupre), not the '~$1/1k comparable' guess. 2) maximedupre/uzum returns order counts only when the source provides them; neither actor is confirmed to emit a shop/seller field or shop-level totals -> grouping by seller may require get_product_details (parse.bot, has seller field) or own crawl. 3) parse.bot get_seller_info returns rating, reviews, registration date, description -- NOT legal name/OGRN/phone; those come only from shop page HTML. 4) Oferta 5.3 mandates full name, OGRN (state reg number), address, location on the shop page; INN/STIR and email/phone are not in the excerpt found -> treat 'email/phone (shop page)' field as unconfirmed. 5) Source yields sellers of (likely) Chinese goods and sales velocity, not import facts, shipment size or customs data; m3 estimate is a derived proxy, and sellers may buy from local wholesalers rather than import directly. 6) api.umarket.uz / GraphQL endpoint remains unconfirmed; do not plan on it.

verified.name: O'zstandart / Texnik jihatdan tartibga solish agentligi — Davlat reestri (certificates of conformity register) + annulled-certificate lists
verified.what_you_get: Records of certificates of conformity registered in the state register since 2015; the APPLICANT of a certificate for Chinese-made goods subject to mandatory certification (electronics, toys, textiles, building materials, auto parts etc. per Cabinet resolutions 318/2004 and 43/2021) is by definition the importer. Search (per 2015 norma.uz description) by blank/registration number, issue period, applicant INN or name, product, certification body. The Uzstandart page on gov.uz additionally publishes downloadable lists of ANNULLED certificates for 2022-2025, each naming applicants. Certification application requires shipping documents with a customs arrival mark, so each certificate maps to a real physical import batch.
verified.volume_signal: Count of certificates per applicant per quarter = import frequency; product group (building materials, furniture, electronics, textiles) implies pallet/container-scale batches; one certificate = one customs-arrived consignment. Filter applicants with >=2 certificates/quarter for Chinese-origin goods.
verified.reason: Existence of the agency and its gov.uz portal is confirmed (gov.uz/oz/standart is live with sections 'Davlat xizmatlari reyestri', product certification, recognition of conformity certificates), and the norma.uz article confirms an online check against the State register of certificates existed (introduced Jan 2015, limited to current-year certificates). However, no 2025-2026 result surfaced the actual certificate-register lookup URL, nor any evidence that it still supports search by applicant name/INN or bulk/product-group listing; the Uzbek-language search of gov.uz/standart returned only navigation pages. The claimed downloadable 'annulled certificate lists 2022-2025' did not appear in any result and remain unverified. Several findings weaken (but do not kill) the source for lead-finding: (a) the 2005 product certification rules (lex.uz/acts/683193) lost force 28.12.2024, so the legal basis the proposal cites is outdated; (b) anhor.uz reports the mandatory-certification list was cut by 747 positions and 32 product groups are being moved to declarations of conformity, so coverage of Chinese consumer/building goods via certificates is shrinking and 'coverage: high' is overstated; (c) spot.uz (20 Aug 2025) reports certificates of conformity may now be issued for the whole import volume under a contract, which contradicts the 'one certificate = one customs-arrived consignment' volume signal. Net: source likely exists and is free, but its UI, scrapability and per-shipment granularity are unconfirmed and its scope is narrowing; cannot be confirmed or refuted on existence/access from search results alone.
verified.access_now: Agency portal gov.uz/oz/standart (and /ru/standart) is reachable in 2025-2026 and lists public-service sections (product certification, recognition of conformity certificates, 'Davlat xizmatlari reyestri'), but no search result exposed a working certificate-register search page or its URL; the only description of search fields (applicant INN/name, product, body, period; current-year only) is the 2015 norma.uz article. Annulled-certificate xlsx/pdf lists for 2022-2025 were not found in results. Free, no paywall indicated; captcha/rate limits unknown. Only WebSearch is available in this pipeline, so the register UI cannot be verified programmatically from here; a manual browser check is required.
verified.extraction_plan: 1) Manual one-time verification: open gov.uz/ru/standart and gov.uz/oz/standart/sections/davlat-xizmatlari-reyestri in a browser, locate the State register of certificates of conformity lookup (may be a separate subdomain of the agency) and record its URL, query parameters, whether it allows search by applicant name/INN, by product group, by certification body, and whether results are current-year only. 2) If search by product group / certification body with date range works: weekly scrape of the current-year window by product group, parsing applicant name, INN, product, origin country, certificate number, date; persist to accumulate history since the register exposes only the current year. 3) Treat post-Aug-2025 certificates as contract-level (one certificate may cover the entire contracted import volume), so use cert_count_90d only as a frequency proxy and weight product group (building materials, furniture, electronics, textiles) for pallet/container scale; do not equate one certificate with one consignment. 4) Because 32 product groups are moving from certificates to declarations of conformity, also look for a declarations-of-conformity register on the same portal and ingest it, otherwise coverage of Chinese consumer goods will drop. 5) Check the gov.uz Uzstandart page manually for annulled-certificate lists; if present, download, parse applicant names, dedupe by INN. 6) Enrich INNs via stat.uz / orginfo for OKED, address, director, then 2GIS/Telegram/Instagram for contacts; push scored leads to LogisticsERP webhook.
verified.corrections: (1) 'coverage: high' is overstated: mandatory certification list cut by 747 positions and 32 product groups being moved to declaration of conformity (anhor.uz), so many Chinese consumer/building goods will not appear as certificates. (2) Volume signal 'one certificate = one customs-arrived consignment' is contradicted by spot.uz news (20 Aug 2025) that certificates can be issued for the whole import volume under a contract. (3) The cited legal basis (2005 certification rules, lex.uz/acts/683193, and by extension res. 318/2004) lost force on 28.12.2024; new rules apply and the customs-arrival-mark requirement should be re-verified under current rules. (4) Search by applicant INN/name and the current-year-only limit are documented only in a 2015 article; no 2025-2026 confirmation found. (5) Annulled-certificate lists 2022-2025 on the gov.uz page were not found in any search result; treat as unverified. (6) The url in the proposal (gov.uz/ru/standart/activity_page/sertifikatlashtirish_) did not surface in results; the live Uzbek-language section URLs are gov.uz/oz/standart/sections/davlat-xizmatlari-reyestri and gov.uz/oz/standart/general-menu/2841-2842. (7) Lower confidence from 0.65 to ~0.45 and est_yield to 'unknown until UI verified; likely lower than 100-500 INNs/month given narrowing scope'.

verified.reason: Existence and reachability are positively supported for UzTender: search results (extended) surfaced uztender.com root ("Тендеры и госзакупки Узбекистана"), uztender.com/market ("Рынок госзакупок Узбекистана — статистика и аналитика", snippet: 2,854 open tenders / 2.7 trln UZS, 71,204 procurements / 79.4 trln UZS per year, breakdown by region (Tashkent city 605 bln UZS, 649 lots) and by category (building construction 982.8 bln UZS), page noted as updated ~46 days ago), and most importantly public company-level pages at uztender.com/supplier/{INN} and uztender.com/buyer/{INN} (e.g. MUQAYYAS GROUP INN 306825083: 47 contracts, 6.1 bln UZS, 7 customers, road/asphalt works; BAHODIR CHAROS DILROZ INN 305763804: 27 contracts, 51 bln UZS; also SAID BARAKA FOOD COMPANY 307258338, MOVIY UMMON OIL 302105451, EXPOCITY 310948784, a foreign supplier Oemeta Chemische Werke GmbH). So winner name + INN + contract count + sum + customers + category are exposed per company, which answers the proposal's open question ("verify whether UzTender exposes winner INN") in the affirmative. The gazeta.uz 2026-09-23 article exists and matches the claim (75,123 contracts / 60.6 trln UZS in 12 months; 11,947 winning companies; 161 companies with 50+ wins took 33% of contracts; median contract ~51 mln UZS); note it contains UzTender advertising inserts, i.e. it is partly promotional. BiCoTender also exists with Uzbekistan region/category catalog pages (Tashkent catalog shows 20 of 375 tenders, lot numbers, sums in UZS, deadlines, status like "срок истек"), but full listing requires registration and documentation/alerts are behind a paid subscription; no winner/result data or pricing was visible in snippets. verified.access_now: UzTender: web, publicly indexed pages — uztender.com/market (aggregate stats by region/category), uztender.com/supplier/{INN} and uztender.com/buyer/{INN} (per-company contract count, total sum, number of customers, main categories). Whether full history/export is free or paid is not confirmed; a G2 seller profile exists (g2.com/sellers/uztender) suggesting a commercial SaaS. BiCoTender: Uzbekistan catalog pages viewable without login but truncated (e.g. 20 of 375 in Tashkent food category); full list requires registration; documentation, custom search templates and alerts require paid subscription (price not shown; contact phone +7 495 660-06-03 on site). verified.extraction_plan: 1) Use UzTender category/sector stats on /market to pick goods-heavy categories (equipment, spare parts, IT/electronics, furniture, textiles, medical) and skip works/services (construction, roads, design). 2) Enumerate supplier pages uztender.com/supplier/{INN} via search-engine discovery (site:uztender.com/supplier + category keywords) or by iterating INNs harvested from xarid.uzex.uz results; parse name, INN, contract count, total sum, customers, categories. 3) Filter to suppliers with repeated wins in imported-goods categories and contract sums implying >=3 m3 shipments; treat as "distributor/importer candidates", not confirmed importers. 4) Enrich INN via other sources (customs/FEA registries, company directories, Telegram/Instagram search) for decision maker, phone, Telegram. 5) Use BiCoTender only as a cheap backfill of lot metadata (number, sum, deadline, status) per region/category; do not rely on it for winners. 6) Respect rate limits and ToS; prefer official xarid.uzex.uz for bulk history, UzTender for quick INN-level lookups.
verified.corrections: (a) UzTender does expose winner INN on public /supplier/{INN} pages — upgrade confidence on that point; (b) no evidence that UzTender or BiCoTender provide contact details (phone, Telegram, Instagram, decision maker) — those must come from other sources; (c) no import facts (origin country, volume, m3) are present; the source only proves a company sells to state buyers, which is an indirect proxy for China imports; (d) BiCoTender's "29,847 Uzbek tenders" and "с результатом/winner" flags were not visible in results — only truncated catalogs (e.g. 375 in one Tashkent category) with status "срок истек"; treat BiCoTender as low value and registration/paywalled; (e) the /market page snippet was marked as updated ~46 days ago, so aggregate stats may lag; (f) the gazeta.uz piece is UzTender-sourced and contains UzTender ads — figures (161 companies = 33% of contracts) are the vendor's own analytics; (g) UzTender pricing/export availability remains unconfirmed; (h) dominant sectors are construction/roads/energy/design, so est_yield for China-import leads is lower than "same population as xarid" implies — expect a modest subset after category filtering.

Agency of Statistics confirms EGRPO is real-time and unified with Tax Committee and MinJust bases (UP-113, 2022).
verified.volume_signal: >1M legal entities + IEs in Uzbekistan (Interfax scope statement)
verified.reason: Existence and per-INN access are positively supported by 2025-2026 practitioner guidance. (1) EGRPO: buxgalter.uz "Проверка контрагента в Узбекистане в 2026 году" and "Как получить выписку из ЕГРПО" describe registr.stat.uz search by INN + captcha producing a PDF with activity codes (OKED), INN, registration date, charter fund, founders and their shares, contact phones/address, director name and active/liquidated status; stat.uz "Сведения из ЕГРПО" is free; "Агентство статистики обновило модуль доступа к ЕГРПО" shows the module was recently refreshed (live, not dead). (2) EPIGU: the 2026 article confirms a "Модуль регистрации субъектов предпринимательства ЕПИГУ" where a company is checked by INN across three tabs (announcements, reorganization, liquidation notices); infoproff.com states my.gov.uz gives free INN lookup of legal-entity registration data jointly from MinJust and the Tax Committee; oldmy.gov.uz is indexed and live (all-services page appeared in results). (3) Tax: my3.soliq.uz "Бизнес без рисков" module, soliq.uz open "Определение плательщиков НДС" search by name/INN (returns INN, registration date, VAT certificate), VAT-certificate status memo, tax-gap coefficient on my.soliq.uz, and a daily-updated list of "doubtful" VAT payers on the old soliq.uz tax-risk-analysis section (yuz.uz news confirms GNK publishes such lists). No result contradicted existence, reachability or company-level content. Not verified: the specific URL path /service/77 and the xarid.uzex.uz unreliable-supplier registry (no results either way; the latter is irrelevant to importer discovery anyway). Core caveat confirmed by the source itself: these are validation-only registries with zero discovery/filter-by-OKED capability and no import facts.
verified.access_now: Live and free, but per-INN only and with automation friction: registr.stat.uz search requires a captcha per query and returns a PDF extract; the stat.uz interactive "Сведения из ЕГРПО" service is described as requiring ONEID (id.egov.uz) login with an electronic digital signature; EPIGU module is per-INN by tabs; my3.soliq.uz "Сведения о контрагенте" in the cabinet needs a password issued by the counterparty itself, while the "Бизнес без рисков" module and soliq.uz "Определение плательщиков НДС" search are open; the "doubtful" VAT-payer list on old soliq.uz tax-risk-analysis section is a bulk, daily-updated list. Prior claim of RU/BY IP blocking was neither confirmed nor refuted. No bulk export or OKED filter exists in any of them.
verified.extraction_plan: Use strictly as the final validation stage, never for discovery. Pipeline: (1) lead arrives with INN from a discovery source; (2) query soliq.uz "Определение плательщиков НДС" by INN or name to capture VAT certificate status and registration date; (3) check INN against the daily-downloaded "doubtful" VAT-payer list from the old soliq.uz tax-risk-analysis section (bulk negative filter, no per-INN cost); (4) for leads that pass, pull the EGRPO extract on registr.stat.uz (captcha; PDF parse for status, OKED, charter fund, founders and shares, director, phones, address) or via stat.uz with a ONEID+EDS session held by a staff member; (5) check EPIGU module tabs for reorganization/liquidation notices; (6) write status, VAT flag, risk-list flag, director, founders, OKED, phones into the LogisticsERP lead record and only then push to the manager webhook. Expect manual or semi-manual throughput (tens per day), so apply only to top-scored leads.
verified.corrections: (a) Treat /ru/service/77 as unverified; the verified entity is the "Модуль регистрации субъектов предпринимательства ЕПИГУ" and the generic my.gov.uz INN lookup; link the agent to whichever resolves at run time. (b) EGRPO fields claimed are correct and richer than listed: the extract also carries charter fund, founder share percentages and contact phones, which are directly useful for the lead record. (c) EGRPO full extract via stat.uz may need ONEID+EDS, and registr.stat.uz uses captcha, so a headless browser must handle captcha or a human runs the top-N; budget for manual effort rather than full automation. (d) xarid.uzex.uz unreliable-supplier registry: not found in results and not needed for importer qualification; drop or deprioritize. (e) The "doubtful subjects" list is a bulk negative filter on old soliq.uz (not my3.soliq.uz) and can be ingested wholesale once a day. (f) VAT-payer status is a turnover proxy, not evidence of import volume; keep it as a soft score, not a hard >=3 m3 gate. (g) buxgalter.uz also names iHamkor.uz as a commercial aggregator whose basic card is open but finance/tax/procurement sections require login; it is a candidate for faster validation but is a separate, non-official source.
